en: The programme can change under adverse weather because outdoor telescope work depends on conditions. Keep the educational indoor content valuable in its own right instead of expecting guaranteed eyepiece views. A lower-scoring but operational night is more valuable than a perfect climatological month with no lawful or safe way to observe.

heading.en: A low-impact field routine for Montsec

en: Arrive early, keep the group dark-adapted, follow staff transitions between dome and outdoor instruments, and do not set personal equipment in circulation or accessible parking areas. Finish navigation and equipment checks before darkness, keep white light brief and directed downward, and never block gates, tracks, residences, or emergency access.

Stay near Àger, check in at the Astronomical Park before the session, complete the full two-hour experience, then return directly to lodging on the familiar road. Set a turnaround time before the session begins and preserve enough energy for the return; the final hour should not depend on improvisation.
de: Komm früh, schütze die Dunkeladaption der Gruppe, folge Wechseln zwischen Kuppel und Außeninstrumenten und stelle keine eigene Ausrüstung in Lauf- oder barrierefreie Parkflächen. Schließe Navigation und Ausrüstungscheck vor Dunkelheit ab, halte Weißlicht kurz und nach unten gerichtet und blockiere niemals Tore, Wege, Wohnhäuser oder Rettungszufahrten.

Übernachte nahe Àger, checke vor Beginn im Astronomical Park ein, absolviere das vollständige zweistündige Erlebnis und kehre direkt auf vertrauter Straße zur Unterkunft zurück. Lege vor Beginn eine Umkehrzeit fest und bewahre genügend Kraft für den Rückweg; die letzte Stunde darf nicht von Improvisation abhängen.

body.en: Reach the park with a generous daylight margin, use official parking, and identify reception, accessible routes, toilets, and the return junction. Mark the exact vehicle position and walking line while they are still easy to recognize, then identify the simplest safe retreat.

body.en: Follow the planetarium and telescope sequence, accept weather substitutions, and preserve darkness between activities rather than checking bright screens. Allow eyes to adapt, keep screens dim, and place equipment where another visitor, resident, animal, or vehicle will not encounter it unexpectedly.

body.en: Return to Àger or nearby lodging after the programme without searching the reserve for a second informal observing point. Pack deliberately, count small items, restore the surface, and use the preselected route rather than adding an unresearched stop after midnight.
